Enabled.Name: Token context menu
Enabled.Hint: Show the Token HUD (right-click a token) as a menu with icons and descriptions. Turn it off to get Foundry's plain icons back on this computer.

FixedSize.Name: Keep menu size when zooming
FixedSize.Hint: The menu keeps the same size on screen whatever the canvas zoom. Off: it grows and shrinks with the map, like Foundry's own icons.
